rationale.observed_ranked_k2: Preserved baseline false routes and reduced paired mean latency by 32.35 ms, but lost 17 baseline-correct cases, leaving supported accuracy at 0.595052 and p95 3.09 ms above baseline.
rationale.paired_discordance: The lost cases are predominantly supported multilingual paraphrases that entered the semantic uncertainty band and were rejected by bounded pairwise scoring; near-domain false routes remain the same downstream baseline errors.
rationale.design_response: Treat agreement between the semantic-seed top route and bounded pairwise top route as graph corroboration when pairwise absolute-score gating abstains. Treat disagreement as negative evidence and fail closed. No extra model inference is added.

frozen_geometry.corroboration_rule: accept only if semantic-seed top route equals pairwise top route after pairwise abstention

candidates.description: semantic top-2 registered routes plus all registered siblings of the seed tool
semantic top-2 registered routes only; do not append seed-tool siblings

selection_rule.primary: highest harmonic mean of supported-operation routed accuracy and near-domain unsupported rejection among all-gate passers
selection_rule.no_winner: Continue graph-derived negative-evidence/semantic-representation development on fresh dev only. Do not generate calibration or v15.
